description: Evidence ledger. Every measuredFrom citation (path:line[-line]) used anywhere in this repo is listed here with the text expected inside the range. Paths are relative to the SOURCE project (the cloned site), which is NOT shipped with this package: extraction/verify_all.py verifies ranges and quoted text when the source tree is present (flag --source-root or sibling folder) and degrades to a warning when it is absent.

sourceProject.name: Transform9 clone
sourceProject.authority: live site measurements in CLONE_SPEC.md and specs/*.md; QA/audit/motion files carry measured corrections that outrank the original brief

wordBudgetMethod: maxWords = next multiple of 5 at or above observedMax (minimum 5), where observedMax is the largest word count of that field across every real instance in the source (content/*.json, src/data/*.js, CLONE_SPEC/specs copy). Words are whitespace-separated after treating U+00A0, U+2028 as spaces and dropping U+200B/U+200D. observedMax is stored beside each budget; verify_all.py checks maxWords == roundup5(observedMax). The rounding rule is a design-repo policy, not a measurement. Structural list sizes (minItems/maxItems) are the exact observed counts.

structuralNotes.summary: src/pages/PageStub.jsx is MOUNTED, not dead: resolveRoute() returns it as the not-found fallback for every path that matches no route and for blog/case-study slugs whose content does not exist. It renders the full shell around an empty min-height 100vh <section data-page-stub>. It is not one of the 18 in-scope routes, has no template, no section contract and no measured live counterpart; its file comment ("STUB - placeholder for a page family not built yet") is stale. Documented here instead of normalised away.

Pages on external domains are deliberately excluded and stay outbound links: Careers (apply.workable.com), Login (portal.transform9.com), EMR marketplaces, LinkedIn, YouTube. They must not be recreated as routes or templates; the validator rejects /careers as an unknown route.

Assets and content are the real company's, reused for private/internal use only with no redistribution. Forms render all states and submit nowhere; tracking/analytics/reCAPTCHA are stripped (an exhaustive grep of index.html, src/ and public/ for the named vendors found only one explanatory comment in CallAlexModal.jsx and no script, pixel or endpoint).

The original honours prefers-reduced-motion only for the background video; marquees, IX2/IX3 interactions, load intros and Lenis keep running, and the clone reproduces this on purpose. Sections therefore declare reducedMotionFallback parity-unchanged (measured parity), video-still-image (page layers) or static-no-motion; a static settled state for reduced motion was NOT measured and is left as an open human decision.

The live site renders the hidden Call Alex modal (div.modal-wrap) on blog index, blog post and case-study pages and their shared CTA exposes the Call Alex link; the clone sets modal:false for these routes (src/routes.jsx), so the CTA Call Alex link is inert there. The template node lists follow the built clone (and ia/ia.json); this is recorded, not normalised away.

Several measured tokens live only in page-level :root blocks (cms.css, page-compare.css, page-legal.css, page-book-a-demo.css) marked PROMOTE; they are not in src/index.css. The design-repo takes all of them as foundation tokens with citations to the file that defines them.

PROJECT_SCOPE/ROUTES.md count 10 template families for 18 routes; ia.json and this repo have 8 templates because the three legal pages share one template (identical class-key set measured at 1440). This is a deliberate merge, not drift.

Template node order for shell sections follows ia.json (page-layers first, call-alex-modal last), which is a logical layer order; src/App.jsx renders Navbar, Preloader, CallAlexModal, .page-wrap[PageLayers, page, FooterTop], FooterBottom. Page-level section order (inside .page-wrap) matches each page component exactly.

findings.result: does not hold as a statement about HEAD
findings.detail: HEAD is 900a82b (plus uncommitted changes to src/components/cms/cmsHover.js and recon/motion-4/*). git diff --stat 6837462 HEAD over src/, content/, ia/ and tailwind.config.js touches only the CMS hover polish (BackLink, CaseCard, FeaturedPost, PostCard, cms.css, cmsHover.js) and the ia/ files themselves. Routes (18), templates (8), sections (43) and their node lists are unchanged; the design-repo re-derived them from the current source and they equal ia.json exactly.

findings.claim: ia.json $comment: every route and section id is a real match/data-section attribute in the codebase
findings.detail: IA ids are dotted logical names mapped to components through implementedBy (all 43 implementedBy files exist). The real attributes differ: six hero sections all carry data-section="hero"; ids such as compare.evaluation map to data-section="healthcare-evaluation" and content.post-header to "post-header"; shell sections carry data-component (preloader, navbar, mobile-menu...), not data-section. Only transition.black-to-white / transition.white-to-black match a data-section value literally.

findings.claim: shell.call-alex-modal is present on home and /compare (2 routes)
findings.result: holds for the clone, not for the live site
findings.detail: Live renders the hidden modal on blog and case-study pages too (CTA Call Alex link present); the clone sets modal:false there. See structuralNotes LIVE_MODAL_ON_CMS_TEMPLATES and the graph rule CTA_CALL_LINK_NEEDS_MODAL (warn).
The design-repo is a separate artifact: status design-review-pending, productionApproved false. ia.json status "validated" was re-confirmed by running ia/validate.mjs (all hard invariants reconcile).

findings.claim: ROUTES.md status column: every route except Home is "to build"
findings.detail: All 18 routes are built in src/routes.jsx and src/pages/*. QA_REPORT.md also still says "Route in scope: / only" and that the other internal routes 404 locally; both statements predate the full-site build.

findings.claim: CLONE_SPEC section 17b: the big footer logo is hidden at <=767
findings.detail: src/index.css hides .footer-logo only inside the max-width 479px block, and specs/book-a-demo.md states the same (existing rule at <=479); the pixel audits found 0 footer geometry mismatches. The CSS value is used in shell.footer-bottom-reveal.
